item.title: Investigators in Guthrie search get over 4,000 calls to tip line in 24 hours
item.description: Nancy Guthrie, the mother of "Today" show co-host Savannah Guthrie, was reported missing on Feb. 1 and ransom notes were being investigated.

item.title: Extended interview: U.S. Olympic skier Breezy Johnson
item.description: CBS News' Seth Doane speaks with U.S. Olympic skier Breezy Johnson about her plans for her broken and repaired gold medal, her parents, her teammates Mikaela Shiffrin and Lindsey Vonn and more.

item.title: Breezy Johnson has plans for her repaired gold medal
item.description: Team USA star skier Breezy Johnson talks with CBS News about her broken Olympic medal, a superstition, and what keeps her motivated on the slopes.

item.title: Mystery of the missing minute from Epstein jail video solved
item.description: Documents that were part of the Epstein files release help explain why a video released from the night of Epstein's death was missing one minute close to midnight.

item.title: Madison Chock and Evan Bates claim silver in ice dance at 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Madison Chock and Evan Bates claimed a silver medal at the 2026 Winter Olympics on Wednesday following a stunning free dance routine.

item.title: 2/11: CBS Evening News
item.description: The search for Savannah Guthrie’s mother intensifies; In House hearing, Attorney General Pam Bondi faces heavy criticism over Epstein files release.

item.title: One dead, dozens hurt when bus carrying community college baseball team crashes in Iowa
item.description: A community college bus carrying the school's baseball team crashed and overturned in a ditch in rural Iowa.

item.title: 6 killed in Florida cross-state murder spree, police say; suspect also dead
item.description: Six people in Sarasota and Fort Lauderdale, Florida, are dead in what police say is a cross-state murder spree by the same suspect Wednesday morning. The suspect was also found dead, authorities said.

item.title: 1/7: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: The latest reporting from Minneapolis after an ICE agent fatally shoots a woman; Details on the U.S. seizure of two oil tankers linked to Venezuela.

item.title: Justice Department fires U.S. attorney hours after judges picked him for the job
item.description: A panel of judges in New York appointed a new top federal prosecutor in Albany after a Trump nominee was found to be serving unlawfully — but within hours, the Justice Department said it had fired the judges' new hire.
